verdict.rationale: An in-product AI-insights story would normally be a category error for a discrete GPU, but NVIDIA's own RTX 5070 family page markets Project G-Assist, an AI assistant running on the RTX PC that "helps you tune, control, and optimize your system." That implies AI-driven suggestions drawn from the user's system data, so the axis applies. The support rests on a single thin marketing line, with no detail on what data it analyzes or what insights it surfaces. Missing for 10: documentation of what data G-Assist analyzes, examples of the insights or suggestions it produces, insights beyond system tuning, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
